limitations: No standalone SDK StringToBytesNoTerm call is substituted for actual part property/API path

algorithmProposal: Provide explicit bounded/unbounded osUTF8 conversion from UTF16 units; do not use replacement UTF8 encoding for input.
Original Name stores osUTF8(String) for getter and separately osUTF8(String,63) for viewer cache; Description uses osUTF8(String,127).

Mirror original two-pass byte-count and byte-emission behavior. Unbounded counter scans past embedded NUL; emitter stops at first NUL; allocation retains zero padding. Bounded counter stops at first NUL.
Lone low surrogate is skipped. High surrogate consumes the next unit and emits only when it is a low surrogate; invalid follower is consumed/discarded. Dangling high stops scan.

Unbounded count tracks last accepted code unit; if last accepted is NUL it subtracts one byte and one input unit. A nonempty input containing only invalid surrogate units can therefore yield negative byte count and original OverflowException.
Bounded count enforces whole-codepoint byte budget before counting; never split BMP multi-byte or surrogate-pair UTF8 bytes.

Emission writes into zero-initialized allocated count bytes, terminates at NUL and does not shrink allocation to actual emitted byte count. osUTF8.ToString uses Encoding.UTF8.GetString of entire stored length.

Only adopt native helper after differential tests pass all123 real API outcomes including exception categories, bytes, getters and XML output; do not overgeneralize to arbitrary managed String or SQLite persistence.
